# Creative Engines

Creative Engines is a strategy-to-content marketing platform for marketing teams, agencies, and founders.

## Core summary

Creative Engines exists against a specific failure: a brand's approved strategy lives in decks and in people's heads, and every handoff – a new team member, a freelancer, an AI chat – rebuilds it from memory, so what gets published drifts away from what was agreed. Creative Engines helps a team ground the strategy in the brand's own material and in real buyer evidence it can open, test a message on synthetic Mindsets before it is published, and publish content that holds the approved direction. A person approves what survived the test; nothing publishes without them. A performance loop feeds back how the work performed. Creative Engines improves the odds rather than guaranteeing a result, and keeps the marketer's judgment in charge. It is not a generic AI writing tool and not a content factory.

The spine of the product is the Reason to Buy: the reason a brand's buyers choose it, grounded in the buyers' own words through Mindset Intelligence, tested before the spend, and carried across everything the brand publishes.

## The plan: Ground → Test → Publish

The Creative Engines website states the plan in three steps. This repository is where each step opens up; the depth under the three names is what the repository adds.

- **Ground** – build the strategy on the brand's own material and on real buyer evidence, with sources a reader can open. Pages: ./product/brand-knowledge.md · ./product/market-intelligence.md · ./product/mindset-intelligence.md · ./product/brand-strategy.md · ./concepts/mindset-intelligence.md · ./concepts/attention-journey.md · ./concepts/methodology-base.md
- **Test** – put a candidate message in front of synthetic Mindsets: buyer models built from that evidence, never real respondents. Each reaction carries a Believability reading – how convincing that Mindset found the piece. The reading is comparative and is never a prediction of response, conversion, or revenue. A person approves what survived. Pages: ./concepts/test-before-you-publish.md · ./concepts/multi-agent-creative-department.md · ./concepts/anti-slop-stance.md
- **Publish** – turn the approved direction into content that sounds like the brand, reviewed by a person before it represents them. Pages: ./product/creative-studio.md · ./product/content-distribution.md · ./concepts/editorial-governance.md · ./concepts/brand-voice.md · ./concepts/voice-at-ai-scale.md · ./concepts/strategy-grounded-content.md
- **Then it loops** – live results feed back into the next decision. Pages: ./product/performance-accountability.md · ./concepts/compounding-value.md

End-to-end view: ./concepts/strategy-to-content-pipeline.md

## The public entry point

The free brand audit: a brand's URL goes in, and a structured first read of that brand and its buyers comes back by email. It works on the reader's own brand or a client's. Page: ./concepts/free-brand-audit.md

## Public boundaries

This repository does not require source-code inspection and does not publish values visible only in code, private build details, protected methods, or private generation instructions. Current pricing is not published here; it lives at https://creativeengines.ai/pricing/. For volatile public items such as legal pages, current commercial pages, contact routes, and deck assets, use the linked website pages as the live public source.
